# anthropic_user (Resource)

Manages an existing organization member's organization-level role and membership lifecycle (`/v1/organizations/users/{user_id}`).

Because users join an organization by accepting an invitation (`anthropic_invite`) or via SSO/SCIM/JIT, `Create` adopts the existing member by `id` and sets their `role`. **Warning**: Destroying this resource calls `DELETE /v1/organizations/users/{user_id}`, which removes the user from the organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the user (`user_...`).
- `role` (String) Organization-level role (`user`, `developer`, `billing`, `admin`, `claude_code_user`, `membership_admin`, `managed`).

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the user was added to the organization.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `name` (String) Display name of the user.
- `type` (String) Object type (`user`).
